|translation='''Title:''' Rebel Snowspeeder.

'''Card text:''' May carry one additional pilot or passenger. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard.

'''Lore:''' Engineers at the Rebel base on Hoth modified the T-47 airspeeder to fly in the frigid atmosphere of the ice planet. Enclosed.
|notes='''Rebel Snowspeeder (Japanese Reflections II Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Rebel Snowspeeder|Rebel Snowspeeder]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] in January 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Rebel Snowspeeder (Japanese ESB Two-Player)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R104 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections II foil cards, R104.
